claims.claim: Direct Tokunbo Valeo Alternator for Mercedes-Benz M278 - 439741
claims.evidence: Witness photos show an alternator/charging unit with vents, terminals, and a mounting bracket, but no readable make/model/part number is reported (make/model/part number not shown).

risks.risk: Wrong fitment/part number (Mercedes M278 vs another application) leading to incompatibility or incorrect output/connector layout.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the alternator label/engraving/part number and any Mercedes/Valeo markings (including the exact suffix) plus a photo of the connector end.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used alternator with unknown compatibility (worst-case: may not match or may require extra parts).

risks.risk: Not working / weak charging output (alternator may spin but fail under load).
risks.proof: A video or test reading showing charging voltage at idle and at higher RPM (e.g., multimeter on battery while engine runs) and/or a bench test result.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: sold as-is / may need repair).

risks.risk: Bearing/pulley wear or pulley roughness causing noise or eventual failure.
risks.proof: A short clip of the pulley spinning by hand and/or running on a vehicle, showing smooth rotation and no wobble; close-up of pulley/bearing area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having unknown pulley/bearing condition (worst-case: may be noisy or seized).

risks.risk: Regulator/brush or diode failure not visible from exterior dirt/blackened casing.
risks.proof: Photos of regulator/brush area (if accessible) and a test for ripple/diode failure (bench test) or a charging test under load.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown internal electrical health (worst-case: regulator/diodes faulty).

risks.risk: Wiring/terminal integrity issues (corrosion, cracks, loose terminals) that can cause intermittent charging.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all terminals and connector area showing no cracks/corrosion, plus a tug test clip of the connector/terminal stability.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown wiring/terminal condition (worst-case: needs cleaning/repair).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete kit (mounting bolts, bracket hardware, belt, wiring harness).
risks.proof: A photo of everything included laid out, and a check list showing whether mounting bolts/harness/belt are present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete (worst-case: buyer must source missing mounting/harness parts).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the alternator label/engraving showing Valeo branding and the exact part number (including the 439741 marking).
Send a short video of the pulley spinning smoothly (no wobble/no grinding) and show the bearing/pulley face clearly.
Provide a charging test: multimeter readings of battery voltage at idle and at higher RPM (or a bench test report).
Send close-up photos of the connector/terminal area showing no corrosion, cracks, or looseness.
Confirm what is included: mounting bolts/bracket hardware, any wiring harness, and whether a belt is included.
response.reason: The witness report consistently identifies the item as a car alternator/charging unit, so it can be priced at its worst case. However, make/model/part number, working condition, and internal health are not verifiably shown, so the price should assume unknown compatibility and unproven charging performance.
